findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean.
findings.comment: Inspector observed that the bottom of the 2 door cooler has some spilled liquids. CORRECTED: PIC was aware and plans to clean the spill soon, as the cooler has already been sold to another facility after the end of the school year. Ensure that nonfood-contact surfaces are kept from from an accumulation of residue and other debris.
findings.citation_text: 4-601.11(C) Equipment, Food-Contact Surfaces, Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, and Utensils. (C) NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be kept free of an accumulation of dust, dirt, FOOD residue, and other debris.

findings.title: Single use/single service articles are properly stored and used.
findings.comment: Observed boxes of single-use articles (i.e., cups, lids) stored directly on the ground in the storage closet outside of the kitchen. The PIC was educated that all single-use articles must be stored at least 6-inches above the ground to avoid contamination. Ensure proper storage by the next routine inspection.
findings.citation_text: 4-903.11(A) Equipment, Utensils, Linens, and Single-Service and Single-Use Articles. (A) Except as specified in (D) of this section, cleaned EQUIPMENT and UTENSILS, laundered LINENS, and SINGLE-SERVICE and SINGLE-USE ARTICLES shall be stored: (1) In a clean, dry location; (2) Where they are not exposed to splash, dust, or other contamination; and (3) At least 15 cm (6 inches) above the floor.

findings.title: Hands clean and properly washed
findings.comment:
Observed an employee did not use a barrier to turn off the faucet after hand washing. The inspector educated the employee and they re-washed hands using the proper hand washing procedure. Ensure that a barrier is always used to turn off the faucet after hand washing. 

2-301.12: (A) FOOD EMPLOYEES shall clean their hands and exposed portions of arms for at least 20 seconds. (B) FOOD EMPLOYEES shall use proper procedure (C) To prevent recontamination, FOOD EMPLOYEES may use barrier to operate faucet handles. (D) Automatic handwashing facility may be used if APPROVED.

findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible
findings.comment:
Observed there was not paper towels at the hand sink when the inspector arrived. The PIC provided the hand sink with paper towels during the inspection. Ensure there is always paper towels available at the hand washing sink.

6-301.12: Each HANDWASHING SINK shall be provided with: (A) Individual, disposable towels; (B) A continuous towel system that supplies the user with a clean towel; (C) A heated-air hand drying device; (D) A hand drying device that employs an air-knife system that delivers high velocity, pressurized air at ambient temperatures.

findings.title: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage and display
findings.comment:
Observed boxes of food (including, but not limited too, cans of peaches, pears, and granola bars) stored on the floor in the closets. The inspector educated the PIC about storing food at least 6-inches off the floor to protect against contamination. Ensure that food is stored at least 6-inches above the floor by the next routine inspection.

3-305.11: (A) FOOD shall be protected from contamination: In clean dry location, not exposed to any form of contamination, at least 6 inches above floor. (B) FOOD in working containers and packages may be stored less than 6 inches on case lot handling EQUIPMENT. (C) Pressurized BEVERAGE containers, cased FOOD in waterproof containers, and milk containers in plastic crates may be stored on floor.

findings.title: Wiping cloths: properly used and stored
findings.comment:
Observed wet wiping cloths stored in the triple sink not in sanitizer solution. In-use wiping cloths must be stored in chemical sanitizer between uses. The inspector educated the employee and the wet wiping cloths were removed for laundering. Ensure that wet wiping cloths are always stored in chemical solution between uses and laundered daily.

3-304.14: (A) Cloths in-use for wiping FOOD spills for TABLEWARE and carryout containers shall be dry and used for no other purpose. (B) Cloths in-use for wiping counters and EQUIPMENT surfaces shall be held between uses in chemical sanitizer at proper solution and laundered daily. (C) Cloths in-use for wiping raw animal FOOD surfaces shall be separate from other cloths. (D) Dry wiping cloths and sanitizing solution shall be free of FOOD debris and other soil. (E) Containers of sanitizing solution shall be stored off floor and used in manner to prevent contamination. (F) SINGLE-USE disposable sanitizer wipes shall be used in accordance with EPA labels.
